title: 掉落的方块
summary: 正方形依次从空中落到数轴上，遇地面或已有方块停止，返回每次落下后最高堆叠高度。
insight: 对新方块的半开水平区间 [left,right)，枚举所有已落方块；只要区间正长度相交，就能落在该方块顶面，取最高顶面加自身边长。
pitfalls: 仅边界接触不算水平重叠
返回的是每一步全局最高高度
新方块可能同时覆盖多个旧方块，取最高基座

solutions.title: 已落区间枚举堆叠高度
solutions.idea: 保存每个旧方块区间及其顶面高度，线性求新方块基座。
steps: 枚举旧方块，若 max(left,oldLeft)<min(right,oldRight) 则 base=max(base,oldHeight)
height=base+size，保存新区间并更新 runningMaximum，追加结果

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> fallingSquares(int[][] positions){List<int[]> placed=new ArrayList<>();List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();int maximum=0;for(int[] position:positions){int left=position[0],right=left+position[1],base=0;for(int[] square:placed)if(Math.max(left,square[0])<Math.min(right,square[1]))base=Math.max(base,square[2]);int height=base+position[1];placed.add(new int[]{left,right,height});maximum=Math.max(maximum,height);answer.add(maximum);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun fallingSquares(positions:Array<IntArray>):List<Int>{val placed=mutableListOf<IntArray>();val answer=mutableListOf<Int>();var maximum=0;for(position in positions){val left=position[0];val right=left+position[1];var base=0;for(square in placed)if(maxOf(left,square[0])<minOf(right,square[1]))base=maxOf(base,square[2]);val height=base+position[1];placed.add(intArrayOf(left,right,height));maximum=maxOf(maximum,height);answer.add(maximum)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> fallingSquares(vector<vector<int>>& positions){vector<array<int,3>> placed;vector<int> answer;int maximum=0;for(auto& position:positions){int left=position[0],right=left+position[1],base=0;for(auto square:placed)if(max(left,square[0])<min(right,square[1]))base=max(base,square[2]);int height=base+position[1];placed.push_back({left,right,height});maximum=max(maximum,height);answer.push_back(maximum);}return answer;} };
